result.summary: Found 2 visual issues. The most obvious problem is a missing restaurant image placeholder in the “Popular right now” section, and the fixed bottom navigation appears to cover part of the content near the bottom of the screen.

issues.description: The first “Popular right now” restaurant card shows a large grey image placeholder with a broken/missing image icon instead of a restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant image loads correctly, or provide a polished fallback image/illustration that matches the app design.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps or cuts into the restaurant card content at the bottom of the screen, making the pizza image appear partially hidden behind the nav area.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards are not obscured by the fixed bottom navigation.
